integrity: Mathematical proof and finite exact-arithmetic verification; qualitative path reachability, generic spectral determinant factorization, and the six-vertex tie are acknowledged prior work. Historical novelty is not independently established.
scientific_limitations: Unit-weight undirected paths; one unit-amplitude coordinate input; complete n-state Gramian. Discrete H>=n, continuous T>0, gamma>=0; continuous infinite horizon gamma>0. Does not treat trace or worst-case control energy, multiple inputs, nonunit edge weights or identical Gramian matrices.
title: Unimodular single-node reachability and equal controllability volume on every path
